limitations: Unofficial election-night results aggregated by Wausau Pilot & Review from county clerk postings; not an official statewide Wisconsin feed.

Statewide race candidate votes are in results.json; board.json provides per-county aggregate votes, live margin and percent reporting, not candidate-by-candidate county counts.
At last checked, 25 of 72 counties reported and five were final; stale/partial data must be labeled as such.
